rules: When changing a function's return value, update ALL references to the old value in test files — including the it() description string (e.g. it('returns hello world') must become it('returns hello dolly')), not just the toBe() assertion. Missing the description string leaves a misleading test name that references the old behavior.

vitest is installed in node_modules but NOT listed in package.json devDependencies — do NOT add it. package.json is a scaffold-owned file and must not be modified. The existing installation is sufficient for running tests.
